mapper.select: SELECT mp.member_product_id, mp.product_type_code, mp.present_amount, mp.quantity, mp.item_name, mp.item_code, -- 현재 할당된 총액을 계산 (NULL인 경우 0으로 처리) COALESCE(allocated_sum.total_allocated, 0) as allocated_amount, -- 잔여액 계산 = 총 보유액 - 현재 할당된 총액 (mp.present_amount - COALESCE(allocated_sum.total_allocated, 0)) as remaining_amount, 0 as checked FROM member_product mp -- 각 상품별로 현재 할당된 총액을 계산하는 서브쿼리 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT a.member_product_id, SUM(a.amount) as total_allocated FROM action a WHERE a.is_deleted = false AND a.action_type = '예적금' GROUP BY a.member_product_id ) allocated_sum ON mp.member_product_id = allocated_sum.member_product_id WHERE mp.member_id = #{memberId} AND mp.is_deleted = false -- 잔여액이 0보다 큰 상품만 조회 (완전히 할당된 상품 제외) AND (mp.present_amount - COALESCE(allocated_sum.total_allocated, 0)) > 0 ORDER BY mp.created_at DESC

UNION ALL
SELECT mp.member_product_id, mp.product_type_code, mp.present_amount, mp.quantity, mp.item_name, mp.item_code, 0 as checked, -- 현재 할당된 총액을 계산 (NULL인 경우 0으로 처리) COALESCE(allocated_sum.total_allocated, 0) as allocated_amount, -- 잔여액 계산 = 총 보유액 - 현재 할당된 총액 (mp.present_amount - COALESCE(allocated_sum.total_allocated, 0)) as remaining_amount FROM member_product mp -- 각 상품별로 현재 할당된 총액을 계산하는 서브쿼리 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT a.member_product_id, SUM(a.amount) as total_allocated FROM action a WHERE a.is_deleted = false AND a.action_type = '예적금' GROUP BY a.member_product_id ) allocated_sum ON mp.member_product_id = allocated_sum.member_product_id WHERE mp.member_id = #{memberId} AND mp.is_deleted = false AND mp.member_product_id NOT IN ( SELECT DISTINCT member_product_id FROM action WHERE member_product_id IS NOT NULL AND is_deleted = false AND action_type = '예적금' ) ORDER BY member_product_id DESC
